title: TitrateLab peptide COA analysis: vendor-blind aggregates of 96,805 published lab reports (release 2026-10-12)
description:
What this is. Monthly, vendor-blind aggregates of published peptide certificates of analysis (COAs), the lab reports that vendors and buyers post publicly. Release 2026-10-12 covers 96,805 included reports across 68 canonical peptides and blends, 26 named laboratories and 44 calendar months (2022-07 to 2026-09), drawn from 116,363 published entries (115,076 distinct certificate identifiers, an upper bound).

Tables. compounds.csv (one row per compound), compound_month.csv, labs.csv (one row per laboratory label, with a profile link where one exists), lab_month.csv and months.csv, plus manifest.json with coverage, missing-data counts, laboratory rules and SHA-256 hashes, and compounds.json mirroring the file served at titratelab.com/data. Columns are defined in schema/data-dictionary.md inside the archive.

Headline figures in this release. 49.9% of 68,267 quantity results fall within 10% of the printed label; 12.9% of included reports carry an endotoxin result; 0.77% of purity results are reported at zero (compound not identified); 98.4% carry a laboratory verification URL.

Privacy boundary. No vendor, manufacturer, client, submitter, batch or certificate identity appears in any file. Every cell holds at least 10 records; smaller cells are omitted and small laboratories fold into an 'Other labs' row so totals reconcile. Laboratories are named because they are the businesses that issue and publish the reports.

Limitations. The corpus is not a random sample of the market: vials are tested and published by choice, and collection coverage differs by laboratory. Quantity deviation is measured against the printed label only. Extraction is imperfect; completeness is published per field in the manifest rather than assumed. Nothing here is medical advice or a statement about the safety of any product.

Method and provenance. Built from TitrateLab's read-only projection of published lab reports (projection 20261012T021040Z, records observed through 2026-10-12T00:23:06Z). Collection, deduplication, canonical-name resolution and quality rules are documented in the methodology/ directory of the archive. Every number in the README and analyses is rendered from these files by scripts/build_release.py. Per-record evidence with laboratory, client and batch as printed is searchable at titratelab.com/coa.
